rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-9 SIX-BOX (PHYSICS lever, NOT capacity): PREV CHAMPION iter-7 (foe nf24/k7/nb31, 1921p, K=5 tied prox+DC, scalar alpha, 16-ep cosine) hr 0.2515 ssim 0.906 psnr 36.59. iter-8 SCALED the FoE bank nf24->40 and TOTALLY DIVERGED (psnr 1.87, hr 0) -> CAPACITY-SCALING FULLY EXHAUSTED (iter-2/5/6/8 all regressed/diverged); ~1.9-2k params is the architecture sweet spot. FAILURE MODE: iter-7 at psnr 36.59 is only 2.5dB over the LD-FBP floor (34.08); the headroom GATE is RMSE-vs-LD-FBP = the data-consistency residual; at K=5 the tied unroll runs only 5 contraction steps so the DC residual is not driven low enough -> recon is DC-LIMITED, not prior-capacity-limited. CHANGE (~0 added params, PHYSICS not size): DEEPEN tied unroll n_iter 5->7 (reg+alpha WEIGHT-TIED so two more steps add ZERO params; bank stays iter-7 1921p byte-for-byte nf24/k7/nb31 zero-init rbf). epochs 16->12 to fund K=7s +40% proj/backproj per step within the SAME max_train_s=1080 18-min backstop. EVERYTHING ELSE iter-7 byte-for-byte: reg_type=foe, scalar alpha, NO momentum, NO per-step alpha, plain prox, cosine 5e-3->1e-5, train_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, bs=1, val_n=214. STABILITY (why NOT diverge like iter-8 capacity NOR iter-3 momentum): (1) ZERO params added, sweet spot untouched; (2) zero-init rbf => reg=0 at init so seed is 7 plain GD+DC steps; (3) MONOTONE prox contraction (one scalar alpha, plain step) - iter-3 instability was the MOMENTUM+per-step-alpha COMBO, OFF here; (4) cosine LR only DECREASES the step. HYPOTHESIS: deepening K 5->7 drives the DC residual (=RMSE, the headroom gate) lower at ZERO params -> hr ABOVE 0.2515; a MATCH ~0.25 maps unroll-depth saturation. PREDICTED hr ~0.25-0.29., reg_type=foe, n_iter=7, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=12, cnn_layers=3, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=12, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, foe_rbf_init_std=0.0, foe_filter_init_std=0.05, foe_x_range=1.0
